dashboard.subtitle: Overview of your activity

actions.importStoreDesc: Publish to a point of sale

org.subtitle: Structure, users and permissions
org.name: Company name
org.invoiceBrandingHint: The company name and logo appear at the top of every invoice.
org.nameInvoiceHint: This name is printed on the invoice.
org.saveBeforeLogo: Save the company first to add a logo.
org.vatRegisteredHint: Show excl. VAT, VAT breakdown and incl. VAT totals on sales invoices.
org.taxesHint: Tax rates belong to this company and are hidden from other companies.
org.exchangeRateHint: Value of 1 unit of this currency in the default currency. Example: USD = 2900 if 1 USD = 2900 FBU.
org.paymentMethodsHint: Create, edit or delete payment methods. Only enabled methods marked “Available on POS” appear at checkout.
org.settleAsHint: How the register settles this tender (cash, card, mobile money…).
org.deviceCategoryPosHint: Point of sale terminal for transactions
org.assignWarehousesHint: You can assign this device to one or more warehouses.
org.confirmRevokeDevice: Revoke this device? It will no longer be able to sign in.
org.syncTokenHint: Enter this unique token in the Android or Windows app to link the device.
org.syncTokenCreatedHint: A unique token will be generated when you save.
org.assignStoresHint: Several stores can be selected. None means access to all stores.
org.storeRequiredRole: Choose a role to assign the store.
org.pinHint: 4 to 6 digits, unique for each user in the company.
org.cannotManageSelf: This action is not available on your own account
org.passwordReset: Password reset. Active sessions were closed.

registers.openHint: Enter the opening float to start the register session.
registers.formula: Expected = opening + sales + cash in − cash out − expenses

catalog.subtitle: Central catalog, categories and reference data
catalog.galleryEmptyHint: Add images to products to see them here.
catalog.pricesEmptyHint: Add products to display their prices.
catalog.unitsHint: Create, edit or disable the units used on products.
catalog.emptyCategories: No categories available. Create one, then reopen this form.
catalog.emptyBrands: No brands available. Create one, then reopen this form.
catalog.emptyUnits: No units of measure available. Create one, then reopen this form.
catalog.attributesHint: Attributes (color, size…) generate variants: Red / S, Red / M, Blue / S, Blue / M.
catalog.emptyTaxes: No active tax. Create one under Taxes, then reopen this form.

tax.name: Tax name
tax.inclusiveHint: The displayed price already includes this tax. The engine extracts the tax from the price.
tax.compoundHint: Calculate this tax on the subtotal plus previously applied taxes, not on the base net amount.
tax.activeHint: Only active taxes can be assigned to products and invoices.
tax.reportEmpty: No tax collected for this period.
tax.journalEmpty: No tax lines for this period.
tax.calculatorHint: Enter an amount and the taxes to apply. Compound taxes apply after lower-priority taxes.

priceList.hint: A product can have retail, wholesale, VIP and special prices. HT, VAT and TTC follow the product tax.
priceList.currencyHint: Amounts in another currency are converted to {currency} using the exchange rate.

options.hint: Turn a product into several options, such as size or color. Each combination becomes a sellable variant.
options.valuesHint: Type a value and press Enter, or separate them with a comma.
options.empty: No product has been transformed into options yet.
options.selectProduct: Choose a simple product to transform.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Service, appointment, employee, completion, then payment.

promotions.title: Promotions
promotions.subtitle: Discounts, bundles and commercial offers
promotions.specialPriceHint: Unit price applied between these hours, for example 18:00–20:00.

pos.title: Point of sale
pos.subtitle: Register and checkout
pos.scanHint: Enter adds the product. F2 search. F8 pay.
pos.selectStore: Select an active store to open the register.
pos.quantityHint: Enter a quantity of at least 1.
pos.chooseOptionHint: Select the option to sell, then the quantity.
pos.noOptions: No active option for this product.
pos.returnHint: Sale, then a full or partial return. The refund follows the returned quantity.
pos.partialHint: A quantity below the remaining sale creates a partial return.
pos.nothingToReturn: Nothing left to return on this sale
pos.varianceReasonRequired: The manager must justify the difference.
pos.loyaltyTooSmall: The ticket is too small for a reward.
pos.noPaymentMethods: No payment methods configured for this company
pos.mixedMinLines: Mixed payment needs at least two methods
pos.amountMismatch: Payment amounts must equal the total

overview.subtitle: Point of sale dashboard
overview.terminalHint: Open the register to check out customers
overview.connectionHint: Tenant ID, store and access token are in Settings.
overview.ordersHint: View and track store sales / orders
overview.shiftsHint: Open, close and control cashier shifts
overview.loadError: Unable to load the POS overview

orders.subtitle: Sales and orders checked out at the point of sale

shifts.subtitle: Cashier sessions: opening, closing and cash control
shifts.noCurrentHint: Open a shift to start checking out on a register.
shifts.noRegisterHint: No active register. Create one in Organization → Cash registers.
shifts.openHint: Choose the register and opening float. The register session will open automatically if needed.
shifts.closeHint: Enter the counted cash amount to close the shift.
shifts.emptyHint: Open a shift on a register to start checking out.

reservations.subtitle: Customer reservations for the point of sale
reservations.intro: Reservations plan customer arrivals (table, slot, service) before checkout.
reservations.emptyHint: Customer reservations will appear here once they are created.
reservations.needStore: Select a store to manage reservations.

rbac.assignPermissionsHint: Check Create, Read, Update or Delete for each module.
rbac.systemRolePermissions: The system role name stays locked, but you can check or uncheck its permissions.

profile.subtitle: Your personal information
profile.name: Name
profile.emailHint: The email address cannot be changed here.
profile.securityHint: Leave blank to keep the current password.

settings.subtitle: Language, store and application preferences
settings.languageHint: The interface language is saved on this device.
settings.storeHint: Sales and stock use this store.
settings.terminalHint: Use these values to configure the mobile or Windows POS app.

account.title: Account settings
account.passwordHint: Use at least 8 characters. Other sessions will be signed out.

products.name: Name
products.galleryAfterSave: Save the product to add photos.
products.emptyHint: Start by creating your first product in the selected catalog.
products.quantifiableHint: This item is stocked. It can be sold after replenishment, stock control or inventory.
products.serviceHint: This service is not stockable. It is excluded from purchases, transfers and inventory, and is sold directly.

quantifiable.label: Quantifiable item
quantifiable.description: Stocked product: replenishment, stock control and inventory

service.label: Service
service.description: Non-quantifiable service, with no physical stock

simple.label: Simple
simple.description: A basic product without variants or a complex structure

variant.label: Variant
variant.description: A product with variations (size, color, etc.)

batch.label: Batch
batch.description: Tracked by batch, expiry date or serial number

barcodes.scanHint: Scan with the camera or a USB/Bluetooth reader
barcodes.notFound: No product found for this code

beverages.hint: A product bought by the bottle can be sold as a bottle, a glass, or millilitres. Stock is reduced automatically in millilitres.
beverages.cannotRemoveLast: Keep at least one sale unit.
beverages.yieldHint: One bottle yields about {count} doses of the second unit.
beverages.sellHint: Choose the unit and quantity. Stock will be converted to millilitres.

inventory.subtitle: Stock, transfers and alerts
inventory.confirmModalMessage: Confirm this entry? Stock will not be changed yet.
inventory.approveModalMessage: Approve and apply this movement to stock?
inventory.entryHint: The entry does not change stock. Confirm, then confirm again to apply the movement.
inventory.stockableOnly: Only quantifiable items are listed. Quantity must be at least 1.
inventory.transferFlowHint: Store A → request → validation → shipment → transit → reception → store B. Shipment removes stock; reception adds it at the destination.

transferActions.requestHint: Submit the transfer request. Stock does not change.
transferActions.validateHint: Validate the request. Stock still does not change.
transferActions.shipHint: Ship from the source store. Stock decreases and the transfer goes in transit.
transferActions.receiveHint: Receive at the destination store. Stock increases.

inventory.needDestination: A transfer needs two different warehouses. Add a second warehouse before validating.
inventory.needItems: Add at least one item before validating.
inventory.sameWarehouse: The destination warehouse must be different from the source.
inventory.issueHint: An issue removes stock after confirmation and approval. Volume quantities are deducted in millilitres.
inventory.quantifiableOnly: Only quantifiable items can be issued. Quantity must be at least 1.
inventory.openingOnce: An opening balance can be created only once per item and warehouse. Later corrections must go through an adjustment.
inventory.ledgerHint: Current stock = opening balance + entries − sales − losses. Volume quantities are stored in ml.
inventory.cycleHint: Sales and purchases stay open. Theoretical stock is snapshotted when the count starts.
inventory.cycleNoneDue: No items are due for this filter.
inventory.uncounted: {count} item(s) still need a physical count.
inventory.fullCountHint: Every product currently in stock is loaded. Theoretical stock is snapshotted, then you enter the physical count.
inventory.spotHint: Select the products to check. Theoretical stock is snapshotted, then you enter the physical count on the same sheet. Sales stay open.
inventory.noStockToCount: No products in stock to count for this warehouse.
inventory.lockMovements: Block sales, purchases and transfers during the count
inventory.physicalHint: Scan a product, or type the physical stock. Example: system stock 100, physical stock 97, difference −3. Validation creates an adjustment movement.
inventory.scanMiss: No product in this count matches that code.
inventory.adjustmentPosted: {count} adjustment movement(s) created for the variances.
inventory.previewHint: Review the items. You can still edit them until the inventory is confirmed.
inventory.previewLocked: Inventory confirmed. Quantities can no longer be edited. Confirm again to apply stock.
inventory.previewApplied: Inventory confirmed and applied to stock. Quantities can no longer be edited.
inventory.noOpeningArticles: No stockable item in the catalog. Create a product first, then reopen this count.

opening.label: Opening balance
opening.description: Enter opening stock for new products not yet in this warehouse

full.label: Full count
full.description: Count every product in stock — items are loaded automatically

cycle.label: Cycle count
cycle.description: Count selected products from existing stock by rotation

inventory.movementRule: Stock is never reduced directly. A sale writes a SALE movement, then the balance. History keeps both lines, for example +100 OPENING and −3 SALE.

suppliers.subtitle: Suppliers and contacts
suppliers.name: Supplier name
suppliers.activeHint: Inactive suppliers will not appear in purchase order selections

customers.subtitle: Customers and loyalty
customers.name: Customer Name
customers.nifRequired: Tax ID is required for a company.
customers.creditLimitHint: 0 means no ceiling. A credit sale increases the balance.
customers.saveFailed: Could not save the customer. Check the name.
customers.ledgerHint: A credit sale increases the balance. A payment reduces it. Movements stay in the history.
customers.ledgerEmpty: No movements. The opening balance is 0.
customers.paymentHint: Example: 50,000 after a 100,000 sale. The balance becomes 50,000.
customers.loyaltyHint: 1000 spent = 1 point. 1 point = 1.00 of store credit, usable at the register.

purchases.subtitle: Procurement cycle, from requisition to payment

hub.paymentsHint: Payments update the remaining supplier invoice balance.

purchases.supplierRequired: A supplier order needs a supplier, otherwise reception cannot increase stock.
purchases.workflowHint: Order → reception → stock → invoice → payment. A reception writes a PURCHASE movement and increases stock.
purchases.receiveHint: The received quantity increases warehouse stock, then creates the supplier invoice.

sales.subtitle: Sales history and returns
sales.selectStore: Select an active store to view sales
sales.storeHint: Check the active store at the top right — sales are filtered by store.

expenses.subtitle: Transport, electricity, rent, salary, urgent purchase, maintenance
expenses.linksHint: An expense is linked to a branch, and can also be linked to a cash session, a user and a category.
expenses.label: Label
expenses.name: Name

payables.title: Supplier payables
payables.subtitle: Supplier accounts, due dates and payments

stores.title: Store assortment
stores.subtitle: Pick catalog items, then import them into the active store.
stores.searchCatalog: Name, SKU or barcode to import
stores.none: No products imported in this store.
stores.leaveEmptyForDefault: Leave empty for the catalog price
stores.sourceHint: Check items that are not yet in this store.
stores.storeHint: Items sold in this store. Adjust the price if needed.

desk.hospitalityHint: Tables, kitchen and rooms — the same desk as mobile and Windows.
desk.productionHint: Pizza recipe = flour, cheese, sauce, meat. Production decreases ingredients and increases the finished product.
desk.noRecipes: No recipes. Create a bundle product with components.
desk.barcodesHint: Look up, generate and print store barcodes.
desk.syncHint: Mobile and Windows terminals linked to this store.

importExport.subtitle: Import and export the product catalog
importExport.exportHint: Download all catalog products as CSV.
importExport.importHint: Import a CSV file (sku, name, base_price, cost_price…). Amounts are in cents.
